comments.name: Almog Tavor
comments.text: they basically want to take whatever content you’re learning and remix it into non-repetitive formats w/ a nice ux. key trick: they personalize the source text first, then use different ai setups for each format (slides, quizzes, maps) all downstream stuff is already tailored. also wild that they had to train a special model just for educational diagrams, since generic image models flop at pedagogy
